body.contents: You start with 10 hearts, and 20 is the most. A player kill moves one heart from the victim to the killer. Dying to anything else costs nothing.
At 0 hearts you're out for 24 hours, then back with 3. A friend can bring you back sooner with a Revive Beacon.
Claim your base with a golden shovel: right-click two corners. Nobody can grief or loot a claim, but you can still be fought in one. Unclaimed land is fair game.
Your first 3 hours come with newbie protection from PvP.
